reviewed: Immutable ELF topology cache bounded by 32 own dest0 vertices, 64 original TRI commands and 64 total triangles; live mutable material remains current until preflight/classification/validation complete.
Terminal polling accepts hardware preflight OR fallback. Successful raw LOAD on geometric fallback is retained lazily for canonical CPU handling; raw failure falls back to CPU transform.
A fully culled accepted task does not prepare material. Live tasks use existing material preparation and explicit material eligibility/LOD/alpha rejection before hardware validation.
Packet numeric validation must complete before the exact serial/context marker is emitted. Marker forces publication, preserving progress of next ownership wait.
Canonical fallback and surviving old slots are materialized before raw storage reuse; actual wrapper blocks new aliases while validation/output owns its port and drains accepted aliases first.
Every mesh marker invalidates software VC residency, so later legacy draws reload their required slots in stream order.

Vertex and command source offsets share generation ownership. Arena recycle drains mesh owner, clears both descriptor caches, and command allocation that recycles after vertex lookup retries BOTH offsets.
Only frozen same-ELF capability-off baseline against candidate can establish frame-time change; no charged-work subtraction is accepted.

GPU payload-underflow and soft-reset output-pointer rules must use separate STREAMED_COMMANDS so new bridge remains ordinary opcode semantics. Root fixed this before native-v2.
